A negative Q^2 would correspond to a timelike photon, which is outside the exclusive electroproduction process EXCLURAD (eta configuration) is built to compute radiative corrections for. To proceed, please supply a Q^2 >= 0 (e.g. Q^2 = 0.5 GeV^2 if the sign was a typo).
